name: K-T2d
description: The diagnosis of the black own clouds of K-T2 start 42 (.local/plans/atmospheres/K-T2-black-clouds-diagnosis.md, 'One game start would settle the rest'). One start, the variant plain only, no timing, about 4 minutes of scenario (the limit is 8). Same pins and guards as K-T2 (raytracing Off, frame generation off, quality NativeAA, window 1707x960, no frame cap, EVE removed, weatherEffects/genEnabled/enabled on, the log guard, the pictures collected); no GPU profiler (its markers change the camera's buffers). The clock step emits the cover of all 48 candidate hours (T09.cover.<ut>) and picks two universal times with the sun at about the same height, both 30 to 55 degrees up (else both 15 to 60; T09d.sun_band_narrow, sun_band_min_deg / sun_band_max_deg, sun_elev_diff_deg): the hour with the lowest cover available ('low', band 0.2 to 0.4) and the hour nearest 0.7 (band 0.6 to 0.8, 'high') that is at least 0.15 above it; a pick outside its band is flagged by T09d.cover_off_band, and the start fails only where no pair is 0.15 apart (T09d.covers_distinct). At each, in the views ground (200 m, looking 18 degrees up) and above (8300 m, 25 degrees down), poses held (the vessel's centre of mass within 5 m of the point for 30 frames before each capture, 20 m at most at the read; expected: all frames pose_ok) and verified at every capture: the baseline frame (the pass runs with no layer drawn), cloud.sunGain 1, 4 and 16 (one frame each; g64 was dropped for the coverage variants, the sun colour of the pass read back and checked), and aid 4 (direct light, light taps, ambient as colours) at gain 1. Every frame is read as raw target values (no gamma step) and measured in three regions: the sky above the horizon (the horizon row from the camera's pitch and field of view), the sunlit sea or ground below it, and the deck (the pixels the pass changed against the baseline); the vessel's box is left out. Rows T09d.<view>.<cover>.<gain>.<stat> with sky_/ground_/deck_ n, p10, median, p90, r, g, b, clipped; deck_fraction; peak; the ratios deck_over_off_sky, deck_over_off_ground (the white reference: the sunlit sea of the baseline), sky_over_off_sky, ground_over_off_ground, deck_vs_g1 (gain 4, 16, 64 over gain 1). The light and the target are logged at the first drawn frame and every 30 s ('T09d env <key>: ...': Sun.Instance.sunLight and the other directional lights, the frame's sun colour and direction with its elevation, the ambient mode and values, Scatterer, SunAirHeightM, allowHDR, the camera target's format, the colour space, the camera's distance from the planet's centre against the vessel's altitude, the composition, the command buffers on the camera and its components); the first set is also in rows T09d.env.<key>. Pictures: half size, t09-diag1707-<view>_<cover>-<gain>-1707x960-natural-half.png (aid: -aid-direct-half). EXPECTED RESULTS, written before the run (values are raw luminance of the camera target; start 42 at cover 0.514 measured the ground sky at median 0.020, p90 0.063, the cloud areas from above at 0.118 next to a sea of 0.72, the baseline sky at 0.31 / 0.49 / 0.69; the offline raw value of the Player at sun 0.844 to 1.0 is 0.063 to 0.083 on the ground and 0.17 to 0.20 from above). PREDICTION A, units or composition is the cause and nothing after the pass clamps or darkens: the deck median rises in proportion to the gain until the target clips at 1.0 (ground view, high cover: gain 1 about 0.02 to 0.08, gain 4 about 0.08 to 0.32, gain 16 about 0.32 to 1.3 and clipped at 1.0 where the target is not HDR, gain 64 clipped at 1.0; deck_vs_g1 at gain 4 is 3.2 to 4.4; deck_over_off_sky climbs from 0.04 to 0.15 at gain 1 through the sky's level (1.0) at a gain of 6 to 25; above view: gain 1 about 0.1 to 0.2, gain 4 about 0.4 to 0.8, gain 16 clipped), and the deck over the baseline sunlit sea at gain 1 is the factor the sun's unit is short by (start 42: 0.16 from above, 0.03 on the ground). PREDICTION B, something after the pass clamps, darkens or replaces the colour (an image effect, Scatterer's extinction, the composite not being rgb + dst x (1 - alpha), a different target): the deck median stays near its gain-1 value or saturates at a constant whatever the gain (deck_vs_g1 at gain 4 under 2, gain 16 about the same as gain 4, deck_over_off_sky at gain 16 under 0.2, the deck's peak does not follow the gain); the checks on the sun colour of the pass (it follows the gain) rule out a gain that never arrived. The aid 4 frame separates the two inside the pass: its direct light (r) at gain 1 should be of the order of the sun colour's luminance 0.844 times the transmittance (tenths) under A or B alike; a deck median 10 times below it points at what the pass does with the light or at what follows it, while a direct light as small as the deck points at the light the pass is given (the T09d env lines name the sun light, the ambient and the colour space). At the low cover (about 0.3) the deck is broken or absent (deck_fraction 0 to 0.5; no deck rows is a legitimate result), and the baseline shows the clear sky for the first time; the point of the second cover is the deck fraction and the sky_over_off_sky of a sky the pass leaves alone (1.0). A diagnosis always yields data: a pose that is not the view's (T09d.<view>.<cover>.placed_ok, <gain>.pose_ok, T09d.frames_pose_ok / frames_pose_bad) is flagged and the frame is read and saved anyway (kt2d.py leaves such frames out of the verdict); only a lost scene or a dead vessel ends the start. The cover scan reads 48 hourly and 110 far candidates (7800 s steps, 10 days); the product has no override of the cloud cover, so when no hour is under 0.4 the nearest is taken and T09d.cover_off_band is 1. START 44 FOUND (2026-11-12): prediction A; ground high deck median 0.0145 / 0.0584 / 0.219 / 0.755 at gain 1 / 4 / 16 / 64 next to a sky of 0.458 and a sunlit sea of 0.443 (sun 15.6 degrees up, sun colour luminance 0.415), proportional to the gain. THE FIX (CloudOutputStage): the pass is radiometric and Unity's legacy lights have no 1/pi, so the pass is given pi times the scene's sun colour (cloud.sunUnit, ambient untouched), and its radiance is encoded relative to the sun's display value W in the final composite, D = W (c * exposure / W) ^ (1 / gamma) (cloud.exposure 1, cloud.outputGamma 2.2; gamma 1 = off). CHANGED IN THIS SERIES: the gain ladder g1 g4 g16 runs with the stage forced off (cloud.sunUnit 1, cloud.outputGamma 1), so its rows and verdict are start 44's; after it, per view and cover, three more frames at gain 1: u1 (sun unit pi, no gamma), p1 (the product's defaults), pe2 (the product's stage at exposure 2); and rows T09d.<view>.<cover>.layer<l>_map_cover / _map_type, the pass's own map values at the site per layer (the cover the series picks is the field's at 3 km; the rain deck reads its map at its mid height). EXPECTED FOR THE STAGE, written before the start (ground view, high cover, same pick as start 44: raw deck 0.0145 at gain 1, sea 0.443, sky 0.458): u1 deck median 0.0456 (u1 / g1 = pi, 3.0 to 3.3; deck over the sea 0.10); p1 deck median 0.152 (0.12 to 0.19), p1 over the sea 0.34 (0.27 to 0.43), over the sky 0.33 (0.27 to 0.40): well below the sea, as a thick base lit by diffuse light is, and no longer 3 percent of it; pe2 deck median 0.208, pe2 / p1 = 2 ^ (1 / 2.2) = 1.37 (1.30 to 1.40). Above view, high cover (raw deck 0.311 = ambient about 0.20 in display units + direct about 0.11; sea 0.432): u1 about 0.55 (u1 / g1 1.5 to 2.6 because the ambient is not scaled), p1 about 0.47 (0.35 to 0.60), p1 over the sea 1.1 (0.8 to 1.4: a cloud top is about as bright as the sunlit sea). Not changed by the stage: the sea and the sky (ground_over_off_ground and sky_over_off_sky 1.0), the aid frame (the stage skips aid views; its direct light is pi times start 44's because the sun colour is). The stage's expected numbers are checked in tests/ReDefinition.Tests/Atmospheres/T09/CloudOutputStageTests.cs and tools/weather_metrics/kt2d.py (stage.* rows, stage.verdict 1 = inside the bands). EXPECTED FOR THE COVER MAP (CloudCoverModel, same test file): a map value of 0.473 under the rain deck (coverage 0.5, edge 0.2, noise amount 0.3) closes more than 60 percent of the sky for the Stratus type at 18 degrees up and at the zenith, 0.3 closes under 45 percent, 0.6 closes over 95 percent: the closed share is a ramp 0.3 wide in the map value, centred where the coverage threshold puts it (0.41 to 0.43 for half the sky at map 0.5, the file has 0.5); layer<l>_map_cover tells which value the shape actually saw. Measured in the same package; the result is read from the rows, no constant is fitted. COVERAGE VARIANTS (owner decision open: the rain deck's coverage 0.5 of the file against about 0.42): after p1, per view and cover, the product's stage at gain 1 with the runtime key cloud.coverageShift (CloudCoverShift, default 0 = the file) at -0.08 (tag c42, coverage 0.42) and -0.15 (c35, coverage 0.35); p1 is the shift-0 frame. Rows per frame: sky_closed_share and ground_closed_share (a proxy from the picture, no alpha is read: the share of the region's samples whose largest channel changed by 0.15 or more against the baseline, T09Readout.ClosedChange, about an opacity of 0.6 or more; the ground view reads the sky, the above view the ground region. START 48 FOUND (2026-11-13): the old definition, deck samples at 0.9 of the region's 90th percentile of change, read 0.07 for ground high and 0.26 for ground low where the pictures show towers and a closed sheet; and layer<l>_map_cover read 1.0 and map type 0.0 in all four layers at both covers because the layer stack held no maps (StackMapMirror now copies the fetched maps into it), so model_closed was 1 everywhere. Checked offline on the saved p1/c42/c35 pictures of the four view/cover pairs: ground low closed share 1.00 at p1, c42 and c35, ground high 0.14 / 0.00 / 0.00, above low 0.81 each), sky_deck_share, ground_deck_share, deck_fraction, the deck median, the picture (natural, and aid on the p1 frame); c42.coverage_shift, c42.rain_coverage, c42.shift_reached say that the shift reached the layer. EXPECTED, written before the run, from CloudCoverModel (Stratus of the rain deck, sigma 0.045, equivalent thickness 622 m, edge 0.2, noise amount 0.3, uniform shape noise, closed where tau > 4.605; the run writes the same numbers as T09d.<view>.<cover>.<tag>.model_closed at the measured layer map value): closed share of the sky by the layer map value, coverage 0.5 / 0.42 / 0.35, ground view (18 degrees up, slant 3.24): map 0.40: 0.47 / 0.20 / 0.00; 0.473: 0.71 / 0.44 / 0.21; 0.514: 0.85 / 0.58 / 0.35; 0.55: 0.97 / 0.70 / 0.47; 0.60: 1.00 / 0.87 / 0.63; 0.64: 1.00 / 1.00 / 0.77; at the zenith (slant 1): 0.473: 0.63 / 0.37 / 0.13; 0.514: 0.77 / 0.50 / 0.27; 0.60: 1.00 / 0.79 / 0.56; from above (25 degrees down, slant 2.37): 0.473: 0.70 / 0.43 / 0.20; 0.514: 0.83 / 0.57 / 0.33. So the shift to 0.42 lowers the closed share by 0.2 to 0.3 where the map is 0.47 to 0.6; the 15 to 25 percent of coverage 0.42 belong to a map value of about 0.40, and a closed share of one half at map 0.5 needs coverage 0.41 to 0.43. The picture's proxy is read beside the model, expected within about 0.15; at the low cover (map about 0.3) the deck is at most 13 percent closed at coverage 0.5 and none at 0.42. The time budget holds: per view 10 frames (off, g1, g4, g16, u1, p1, pe2, c42, c35, aid), 40 in all against 36 before, the limit 8 minutes. START 49 FOUND (2026-11-13): at the low cover (field 0.473; the CPU readers' layer maps 0.406 / 0.665 / 0.110 / 0.501, type 0) the ground sky is a closed sheet at every shift (closed share 0.994 / 0.984 / 0.970 for 0 / -0.08 / -0.15) while at the high cover (maps 0.859 / 0.206 / 0.661 / 0.177, type 0.229) the cumulus responds monotonically. START 50 ADDS (ground view only, both covers): for k = 0..3 a frame with only layer k drawn (Frame.LayerMask = 1 << k) at shift 0 (tag only<k>) and at -0.15 (tag only<k>c35), 16 more frames (56 in all, about 5 minutes against the limit of 8), each with closed share, deck_fraction, deck median and the natural picture, and per layer the rows T09d.ground.<cover>.L<k>.* : info (text: name, group, type name at the CPU type value, coverage, softness, noise amount, sigma, thickness), coverage, softness, eq_thickness_m, cpu_cover / cpu_type (the stack's CPU copy), gpu_cover / gpu_type (the bytes the module uploads, LayerMapStore, at the vessel's place), gpu_goal_cover / gpu_goal_type (the target the slew moves toward), shader_cover / shader_type (the same bytes where the shader's MapUv puts the camera: the map frame applied to the camera's position), gpu_minus_cpu_cover, shader_minus_cpu_cover (warnings gpu_map_differs and shader_map_differs above 0.05), model_closed_p1 / _c42 / _c35 (CloudCoverModel.LayerClosed at the CPU map value, tau above 4.6); and per cover T09d.ground.<cover>.layers.* : stack_key (text), stack_cold (the group member, 0 = rain deck), surface_temp_k, cpu / shader lat and lon and their difference. kt2d.py prints the table per layer (CPU map, GPU map, pass sample, drawn closed share at p1 and c35, model, deck fraction, deck median) and the metrics T09d.ground.<cover>.layers.sheet_layer (the layer whose own closed share is highest at shift 0) and gpu_matches_cpu (1 / -1). EXPECTED, from CloudCoverModel.LayerClosed with Clouds-Kerbin.cfg's layers (rain deck coverage 0.5 edge 0.2 noise 0.3 sigma 0.045; cumulus 0.35 / 0.15 / 0.35 / 0.05; cumulonimbus 0.12 / 0.1 / 0.4 / 0.08; cirrus 0.3 / 0.35 / 0.5 / 0.0002) at start 49's CPU maps, sky at 18 degrees up, closed where tau > 4.6, p1 / c42 / c35: low cover layer 0 (Fog at type 0, 119 m equivalent) 0.34 / 0.07 / 0.00, layer 1 (Stratocumulus, 436 m) 0.73 / 0.50 / 0.30, layer 2 0.00, layer 3 0.00 (too thin); high cover layer 0 (Fog and Stratus, 322 m) 1.00 / 1.00 / 1.00, layer 1 0.00, layer 2 0.08 / 0.00 / 0.00, layer 3 0.00. THE SHEET AT THE LOW COVER IS EXPECTED FROM LAYER 1 (the cumulus layer, Stratocumulus at type 0): it has the largest model value and is the only one still 0.30 closed at c35; the sum of all layers at the picture's opacity threshold (tau above 1) is 0.87 / 0.64 / 0.33, against the measured 0.99 / 0.98 / 0.97, so the pass draws more than the CPU maps give: a GPU map above the CPU one in layer 1 or 0 (gpu_minus_cpu_cover) would explain it. At the high cover the CPU maps make layer 0 a closed sheet (1.00) that the pictures do not show: only0 at the high cover should show it is not drawn (or its GPU map is far below 0.859). Run: python tools/atmo_series.py run K-T2d --who <name> (preflight first: python tools/atmo_series.py preflight K-T2d).

starts.description: the own pass at 1707x960 with EVE removed: two covers, views ground and above, baseline, gains 1, 4, 16, the output stage variants, the coverage variants, the layer-alone frames of the ground view and aid 4; about 5 minutes of scenario

E40 start 51, look A (shape and cover; the plan .local/plans/atmospheres/E40-plan-2026-11.md, the numbers .local/plans/atmospheres/E40-phaseO-result.md): the same two cover picks as start 50, but only the frames of the look sets. Per pair ground low, ground high, above low: the baseline, every look set of CloudLookModel (C0 current, C1 humilis at no precipitation, C2 noise, C3 interior erosion, C4 the plan's cfg proposals on the cumulus layer, C5 = C1 + C2 + C3) at shift 0 and -0.08 (frames k<set> and k<set>m8, the type sets wait 6 s for the maps to slew), the sheet layer's map forced to its value at the vessel (kovr), at the ground view the layers one at a time under the winning set (w<set>o<k>) and the rain deck at coverage 0.5 and 0.42 (q50, q42), at the high cover the rain deck alone from inside (4.6 km) and from above (l0in, l0up). Before every frame the probe writes the CPU oracle's expectation (T09d.<view>.<cover>.<frame>.expect_closed_mean / _p10 / _p90 / _sites: CloudCoverOracle over 8 sites of the noise for the camera's height, pitch and field of view, the stack's CPU maps at the vessel, the knobs as forced) and the layers' coverage maps along the view (L<k>.map_at_<d>_km, 0 to 80 km). EXPECTED RESULTS, written before the start (from the player sweeps of Phase O, E40-phaseO-result.md): (1) the closed share of a frame is a wide draw (the oracle's p10 to p90 at shift 0 is 0.21 to 0.99 for one frame at the low pick): a frame inside its expectation's spread plus 0.05 is as expected (kt2d.py: look.<set>.in_spread_s0); the game's start-50 frames (0.994 / 0.984 / 0.970 at the low pick) lie outside what a constant map of 0.665 gives (none of 40 oracle sites reached 0.97 at -0.15); (2) the forced-map frame kovr decides between two explanations: where the map of the sheet layer rises along the view (the map_at_<d>_km rows at 10 to 80 km above the vessel's 0.665) kovr reads the oracle's share and the own-map frame kC0 stays above it (kt2d.py look.ovr.map_varies_over_view 1); where the sheet stays under the forced map the pass or its settings differ from the CPU (-1); (3) the sets: C0 and C3 draw the same closed share (the interior erosion acts on the density, not on the cover; the player's tables agree to 0.002), C1 within 0.02 of C0, C2/C4/C5 close more at maps of 0.665 and above (player: 0.91 / 0.87 / 0.93 against 0.64), every set falls with the shift by at least 0.10 on average; (4) rain deck (P3): the player draws it closed (1.000) from inside at map 0.859 type 0.229, so l0in and l0up read at least 0.6 unless the game draws it differently, which is the finding; (5) rain deck coverage 0.42 against 0.5 (q42 against q50): lower by 0.2 to 0.3 where the deck is half open, no change where it is closed. A pose or a stack the probe cannot read is named, never faked. About 58 frames, 6 to 7 minutes of the 8 minute limit; start with the sets named by -atmoLookSets and the winning set by -atmoLookWin where the budget needs it.

E40 start 52, look B (light and surface). The same pairs (ground low, ground high, above low): the baseline, then the sun tint 0 / 0.5 / 1 (cloud.sunTint: t0, t5, t10), the exposure 1.4 (e14), the sun's path through the air with Scatterer loaded (air1, cloud.sunAirWithScatterer 1), the sun colour of the pass as rows (sun_r / _g / _b), the aid frame of the direct light, taps and ambient (aid4); at the low cover the horizon pose (200 m, pitch +2 degrees) with the distance fade 0 / 20 / 40 / 80 km (cloud.fadeFarM) with the aerial perspective off and on (cloud.farHaze), frames hz<km>h<0|1>, with the band above the horizon as rows (horizon_band_n, horizon_band_closed, horizon_band_change: the share and the median change of a channel against the baseline in the 4 percent of the height above the horizon line) and the oracle's expectation beside each. EXPECTED RESULTS, written before the start: (1) A5: the deck's blue over red (deck_b / deck_r) at t0 is under 0.80 (beige: the sun colour b/r of 0.69 at 45 degrees) and rises monotonically with the tint to 0.85 to 1.0 at t10; sky_over_off_sky and ground_over_off_ground stay 1.0 +- 0.05 in every frame, deck_clipped under 0.001; e14 raises the deck by 1.4 ^ (1 / 2.2) = 1.16 against t0 where it is below the white; air1 changes the sun colour only if Scatterer is loaded (the rows sun_r / _b show it); (2) A7: at hz0h0 the band above the horizon is closed where the sheet is (horizon_band_closed near the sheet's share) with a change of 0.15 or more; with the fade 20 and 40 km the band above the horizon is faded (the player: the deck's alpha in the 0 to 2 degrees above the horizon is 1.00 at no fade, 0.00 at 20 km, 0.003 at 40 km, 1.00 at 80 km, because the layer lies 40 to 50 km away at the horizon), so horizon_band_change falls under 0.10 at 20 and 40 km; the aerial perspective (h1) changes the colour of the far deck toward the sky but not its alpha, so horizon_band_closed is the same at h0 and h1 to 0.05; (3) the expectation rows are written before each frame as in start 51. The plain against recon pair of the plan's start 52 needs the K-T2 variants machinery (the cloudResolution levels) and rides in the K-T2 own1707 set of start 53. About 30 frames, 3 to 4 minutes.

sections.title: Black own clouds: units or composition
